title: SPLA/9/2006 of STATE Vs SMT. YASODA DEVI and ANOTHER

paras.text:
SPLA NO. 9 of 2006
Honíble Prafulla C. Pant, J.
Honíble B.S.Verma, J.
 Sri Tanuj Semwal, learned counsel
present for the State-appellant.
 Sri Rajendra Kotiyal, learned counsel
present for the respondents.
 Heard on leave application no. 9 of
2006 sought by the appellant for filing
appeal against the judgment and order
dated 21.6.2003 passed by the Additional
Sessions Judge, Fast Track Court, Pauri,
Garhwal in Sessions Trial No. 93 of 1999
and 48 of 2002.
 The leave is granted.
 Application is allowed.
 Admit the appeal.
 The respondents are already
represented through their counsel as such
there is no need to issue fresh notices.
 Lower court record has already been
received. Registry is directed to prepare the
paper book.
 List this appeal for final hearing in
due course.
